RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; a 0–100 estimate would be speculative.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Neither panel members’ sex nor the successful candidate’s sex establishes whether discrimination occurred.

Your stronger academic record warrants asking how the published criteria were applied, but industry experience, teaching assessments and interview performance may legitimately affect the ranking.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weightings, your assessment and any available review procedure. If a completed PhD was mandatory, ask specifically how that requirement was satisfied.

Check local appeal deadlines promptly. Raise concrete procedural inconsistencies or evidence of bias—not panel composition alone.
